title: Fast-track court to hear bail pleas of Dinesh and Vikas Biwal in NEET UG paper leak case
summary: A fast-track court will begin hearing cases related to the NEET-UG paper leak, with accused Dinesh and Vikas Biwal's bail pleas scheduled for first on the list. The court will hold its first hearing in Rouse Avenue Fast Track Court. The hearing is expected to take place soon. The court has received several bail pleas from the accused. The police have claimed that the leaked papers were stolen from a hostel room. The government has assured that it will ensure the safety of students and teachers. The opposition alleged that the leak was caused by negligence on the part of the university administration.
